messages:
zoe-billing: Alert: customer TideBox (TB-900) attempted ACH verification but both micro-deposits bounced. Bank returned error: "invalid routing number". Customer insists routing was copied from their portal.
ali-support: Opening a support thread. Can we see the raw ACH instrument fields? Could be a transposition or a missing leading zero.
mike-payments: Pulling instrument: routing=110000195 (vault id ach-TB900). I see a checksum mismatch with expected routing for that bank (should be 0110000195). Looks like leading zero dropped during form submit.
ali-support: Oof. Possible frontend formatting bug trimming leading zeros. @emma-sales were you on the account setup call?
emma-sales: I guided them through self-serve flow; they pasted routing from their bank portal. Noticed our UI shows routing input with number type which might strip zeros on some browsers.
mike-payments: payments-bot scheduled 3 micro-deposit attempts but they were all rejected. Current retry job id: retry-1812345678-1.
payments-bot: Automated retries suspended after repeated bank rejections. Waiting operator to update instrument.
zoe-billing: Immediate actions: revert auto-retries, set invoice INV-2026-905 to payment_hold_manual, and notify customer with corrected instructions. Also file internal bug for routing input.
ledger-bot: Invoice INV-2026-905 status updated: payment_hold_manual. GL note created: GL-2026-TB900-routing-typo.
vivian-legal: For wire fallback, ensure we don't post bank details in plain text if contract class is enterprise. Confirm NDA status.
emma-sales: Customer is SMB but requested same-day ACH/wire. They prefer ACH. I'll ask them to re-enter routing with leading zero and attach a bank statement screenshot.
mike-payments: If they re-submit we can update ACH instrument and kick off a fresh micro-deposit cycle. That usually posts within 48 hours. Alternatively, if they need immediate clearance, accept wire and mark invoice awaiting_wire.
ali-support: Draft to customer: "Hi 11 TideBox — our logs show the routing number submitted was missing a leading zero, which caused the bank to reject the micro-deposits. Please re-enter the routing number with any leading zeros (or upload a screenshot of the routing on your bank statement). If you need immediate coverage, we can accept a same-day wire; let us know and we will send instructions."
zoe-billing: Done. Also created internal ticket FIN-3650 to add validation/hint to the billing form to preserve leading zeros for routing numbers.
emma-sales: Customer replied at 1812345752: they re-entered routing with leading zero and uploaded a bank screenshot. They also asked for wire instructions just in case.
mike-payments: Updated instrument to routing=0110000195 and triggered micro-deposits at 1812345770. Retrying micro-deposit cycle.
payments-bot: Micro-deposits sent: +0.05, +0.11. Awaiting customer verification.
ali-support: Set invoice to awaiting_verification and left a 72h grace to allow them to verify.
ledger-bot: GL update: temp_hold -> awaiting_verification. Memo GL-2026-TB900 updated.
vivian-legal: No NDA needed for wire template, proceed to send redacted wire instructions.
zemma- (typo)
zoe-billing: (fix) Emma, thanks. Sending wire template to support to forward if needed.
emma-sales: Customer verified micro-deposits at 1812345800. Instrument verified, invoice payment queued; marking invoice PAID once ACH settles (2-3 business days).
zoe-billing: Marking invoice pending_settlement. Closing loop. Will monitor FIN-3650 for the frontend fix.
ali-support: Closing support ticket #66145. Customer happy, no service interruption.
zoe-billing: Thanks team. Note: ops ticket to add input type=text for routing to preserve formatting.
